name: smwmusic-make-a-good
title: Make A Good 48 Hour Mega Man Level - Wow You Got the Element! Wow You're the Best!
description:
Did a port of Wow You Got the Element! Wow You're the Best! (by MelonadeM) from Make A Good 48 Hour Mega Man Level. Was replaying this earlier and thought I'd port this banger of a stage clear theme to SMW.

Important:
There are also customizable options for the lead sample that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ0. @0 is the Lead [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. @1 is the Lead

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal Tape SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ0. Disables Goal Tape SFX

Note:
Studies have shown that if this song is used in your romhack, it will increase its coolness by 50%. :)
Source:
Trust me, bro!
